promotion.principle: A safety fixture never authorizes promotion.

safety_controls.principle: Every isolation and lifecycle control must pass within budget.

sealed_panel.principle: All fresh partitions and label boundaries must be complete.

terminal_validation.principle: Cold reduction and both strict readers must pass.

field_principles.inference_substrate: Actual computation, with historical inference in explicitly labeled hash-bound sidecars.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Actual closed duration class; no duration padding.
field_principles.learning_fixture_ready_score: One for safe adapter and complete sealed panel, independent of benefit; no promotion.
field_principles.learning_value_score: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.milestone: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.

field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.phase: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.phase_spans: Disjoint measured load, generation, evaluation, validation and write spans.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact input, resource and required-field checks before dependent work.
field_principles.production_defaults_changed: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.promotion_score: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.random_seed: Frozen development/evaluation/resampling seeds; null if truly inapplicable.
field_principles.raw_evidence_paths: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.repository_health: Dated unrelated failures kept separately from affected required validation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind exact code, settings, evaluator, inputs and raw evidence.
field_principles.research_roadmap_changed: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit/arm/metric/cost/failure/censoring disposition, not only pooled means.
field_principles.safety_rows: Each lifecycle/drift/leakage/mutation control including failed controls.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Frozen planned/attempted/completed/censored units and stopping rules.
field_principles.schema: Version this record and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact producer paths and immutable byte hashes; preserve original classes/flags.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Retain this supporting fixture evidence in its ordinary JSON type.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after actual work and affected validation; never a success-shaped placeholder.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Exact command/scope/return code/elapsed/log hash for every required and diagnostic check, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished retryable OWN work is partial; external unchanged absence is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when the evaluator defines truth; independent code alone cannot remove circularity.

query_advantage_gate.principle: Persistent atoms must reduce total paid work against both reset controls.

host_computation: CPython generation, exact Boolean execution, and transactional adapter controls

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Seal each fixed unit once and run each safety control once; do not extend from outcomes.
